summary: 2x2 box downscale over an 8-bit byte-plane image. Reads the source pixel buffer at obj+0x18 (object at this+0x0) and the destination pixel buffer at destObj+0x18 (object at this+0x4). Stride, row width and row count come from obj+0x1050, obj+0x1058 and obj+0x105C. For every pair of source rows it walks pixel pairs and writes one output byte per 2x2 source block, computing the average (a+b+c+d+2)>>2 of the four source bytes. Source advances two rows per output row; destination advances one row. Returns 0.

operations.description: Read the source image object pointer from this+0x0 and the destination image object pointer from this+0x4.
Read the source pixel buffer pointer from obj+0x18 and the destination pixel buffer pointer reached through the destination object at this+0x4 plus 24.
Read the image geometry from the source object: stride at obj+0x1050, row width at obj+0x1058, and row count at obj+0x105C.
Read the destination row stride from the destination object at +4176.
Compute the source end pointer as source pixel buffer + stride * row count.
Outer loop over pairs of source rows, running while the source pointer is below the row-count-limited end pointer.
Compute the inner row bound as source pointer + row width, and the second source row as source pointer + stride.
Inner loop over pixel pairs, consuming two source bytes per source row for each output byte.
Inner loop terminates when the row source pointer reaches the width bound.
Compute the 2x2 box average: out = (byte at offset 0 + byte at offset 1 + byte of row two at offset 0 + byte of row two at offset 1 + 2) >> 2.
Write the averaged byte into the destination pixel buffer.
Advance the source pointer by two source rows (2 * stride) and the destination pointer by one destination row (destination stride).
Return 0 after all row pairs are processed.
